/-- [aspis_r1_builder_reference::row_arithmetic]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 7:0-10:1

def row_arithmetic (j : Std.Usize) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let i ← j % 4#usize
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 64#usize i)
  let i2 ← j / 4#usize
  let i3 ← i2 % 4#usize
  let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 256#usize i3)
  let i5 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 i4)
  let i6 ← j / 16#usize
  let i7 ← i6 % 4#usize
  let i8 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 16#usize i7)
  let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i5 i8)
  let i10 ← j / 64#usize
  let i11 ← i10 % 4#usize
  let i12 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i9 i11)
  let i13 ← j / 256#usize
  let i14 ← i13 % 4#usize
  let i15 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i14)
  ok (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i12 i15)

end AspisBuilderReference
